name: Vasaka Powder 100gm–For productive cough
original_description:
### Vasaka Powder – 100g | Traditional Ayurvedic Herb for Respiratory Support

Rooted in the ancient wisdom of Ayurveda, Vasaka Powder is prepared from the dried leaves of Adhatoda vasica, a herb long revered in traditional Indian systems for its association with respiratory well-being. Known in Sanskrit as Vasaka or Adulsa, this botanical has been gently incorporated into daily rituals and herbal preparations across generations.

In Ayurvedic tradition, Vasaka is understood to have a balancing influence on Kapha and Pitta energies, often associated with natural moisture and warmth in the body. Its subtle properties are traditionally valued for their role in maintaining internal harmony during seasonal transitions.

This finely ground powder offers a pure, unadulterated form of the herb — ideal for those who prefer traditional methods of herbal use. It can be blended with warm water, honey, or other supportive herbs as part of a personal wellness routine, following customary practices.

Traditional Use Notes:
- Often used in formulations aligned with seasonal respiratory patterns
- Traditionally associated with the gentle movement of subtle bodily fluids
- May be incorporated into daily herbal rituals for internal balance

How to Use:
As per traditional guidance or as advised by a qualified practitioner of Ayurveda.

Storage:
Keep in a cool, dry place. Seal tightly after use to preserve potency.

Net Weight: 100g | 100% Pure Vasaka Leaf Powder | No Additives | Vegan | Gluten-Free

---

Vasaka Powder is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. It is offered as a traditional herbal preparation in accordance with Ayurvedic principles.

---
